integrity: The threshold follows from an exact spectral-mode recurrence and a factored polynomial sign analysis. A standard-library checker independently reconstructs the constants and replays the displayed witness; numerical replay is corroborative rather than the proof of the universal statement.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is limited to classical constant-step FISTA on smooth SPD quadratics with exact step size 1/L and compares the fourth completed iterate with the third. It does not classify later-iterate monotonicity, backtracking, restart rules, monotone FISTA, strongly-convex parameterizations, nonsmooth proximal terms, or inexact gradients.
title: A sharp fourth-iterate objective-monotonicity frontier for classical FISTA on SPD quadratics
